{{Quote|Do not be moved by who they are. It does not matter who they are.|Olianne Sihn on the Jedi|<ref name="backlash" />}}
'''Olianne Sihn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri witch]] and the war-leader of the [[Raining Leaves Clan]], a traditionalist and matriarchal Dathomiri Witch clan led by her sister, [[Kaminne Sihn]].<ref name="backlash" />

In [[33 ABY/Legends|33.5 ABY]], an uprising of the male [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] within the [[Raining Leaves Clan]] resulted in a [[Raining Leaves Clan massacre|massacre]]; the immediate aftermath was the loss of two-thirds of the clan, among them all its males over the age of ten, as well as the clan's leaders. Olianne and Sihn lost their entire family to the massacre, which consisted of their [[Kaminne Sihn's father|father]], [[Kaminne Sihn's mother|mother]] and [[Kaminne Sihn's oldest sister|oldest sister]].<ref name="backlash" />

In the years afterward, the Raining Leaves Clan established an annual conclave with the [[Broken Columns Clan]]—a clan that consisted of men, led by the [[Hapan]]-born [[Tasander Dest]]. A few days before their [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|conclave]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Olianne encountered [[Vestara Khai]], a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], during a hunting trip. Khai was on the verge of collapse, having gone through a [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|fight]] with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]] and later escaped. Khai's plight touched Olianne deeply, as Olianne recently lost her only daughter [[Sesara Sihn]] to a fever a few months prior. Olianne began mentoring Khai and soon planned to adopt her.<ref name="backlash" />

During the conclave, the two clans fought off attacks by [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] and successfully merged into one new clan, [[Bright Sun Clan]], headed by the newly [[Marriage/Legends|wedded]] Sihn and Dest. After the [[Attack on Bright Sun Hill|battle]] on [[Bright Sun Hill]], where the two clans defeated the Nightsisters, Olianne chose to adopt [[Aradasa Vurse]], a child of [[Halliava Vurse]], whom was discovered to be a Nightsister [[Spy/Legends|spy]] among their ranks, while Khai, whose true allegiance to the Sith was discovered, was placed under Jedi custody.<ref name="backlash" />
